headline: Ramayana Day 15: ₹19.35 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana on Day 15 (Friday, 20 November 2026) is at ₹19.35 Cr India nett and ₹23.10 Cr India gross, -16.6% from Day 14's ₹23.20 Cr. The board has 21,437 shows at 16.9% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
body:
Through Day 15 the desk has Ramayana at ₹883.1 Cr India nett, ₹1,032.2 Cr India gross, ₹515.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹863.75 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, ENE Repeat at ₹5.85 Cr and Bachelor Party D'eux at ₹2.55 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. IMDb is citing about ₹650.0 Cr, NDTV is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr, India Today is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹883.1 Cr India nett and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
